interpretation_notes: Single-panel Raman spectrum with two overlaid curves and a full rectangular axis frame. The legend is inside the upper-right of the plot area. The interior text labels "D" and "G" annotate peaks and are not panel labels.

x.visible_pattern: Uniformly spaced labeled ticks from 500 to 2500 along the bottom axis; validator chose a linear mapping with very low normalized RMSE.
x.justification: Axis-fit report chose linear with normalized RMSE about 0.0002; log10 fit was substantially worse.

y.justification: Axis-fit report chose linear with normalized RMSE about 0.0004; log10 is incompatible because the visible axis includes 0.
